product.simple_product_description_content: • Elevate the value of your content with Printly's premium magazine printing service. By combining imported art papers of various weights (Art Paper, Snow Paper, etc.) with sophisticated offset printing technology, we perfectly reproduce vivid colors and detailed images. From sturdy perfect binding to robust saddle stitching, we deliver works of art that go beyond simple information delivery to be felt at your fingertips. Complete a luxurious brand image that captures attention at first glance through various finishing options, such as matte/glossy coating, foil stamping, and partial UV coating.
product.important_note_content:
• [Order Submission and Processing Guide]
  • All orders are accepted after payment is completed, and orders placed after the submission deadline will be processed the following day. We are not responsible for any delivery delays resulting from this.
  • We are not responsible for any production or shipment delays caused by data corrections, re-proofreading, or additional verification due to file errors.
  • The production schedule may be adjusted if changes to the order details or file replacements are requested after the order has been received.
  • [General Notes]
  • Files created using web-based design platforms such as Canva or Miricanvas may cause unexpected issues during printing, such as color differences, font errors, or broken images; these issues are not eligible for rework.
  • We recommend using files created with Adobe programs (Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) for stable print quality.
  • All printed materials are output based on CMYK standards, and there may be color differences between the monitor screen and the actual printed material.
  • Please ensure that all fonts are outlined.
  • We recommend a resolution of 300dpi or higher for print images, and We are not responsible for any quality degradation caused by the use of low-resolution images.
  • A margin of error of ±1–2mm may occur during the cutting process, so please ensure sufficient margins for important elements.
  • Proofreading is considered final approval, and rework is not possible for issues that arise after approval.
  • There may be a difference of approximately ±5–10% between the data colors and the actual printed colors.
  • Color differences may occur depending on the paper type, even with the same data.
  • If you wish to reproduce the exact same colors as a previous order, you must provide the existing printout or a color sample.
product.production_guide_1: All orders are processed after payment is completed, and orders placed after the cutoff time will be processed on the following day. We are not responsible for any delivery delays resulting from this.
product.production_guide_2: We are not responsible for production and shipment delays caused by data modification, re-correction, or additional verification due to file errors.
product.production_guide_3: The production schedule may be adjusted if you request changes to the order details or file replacements after the order has been received.
product.general_precautions_1: Files created using web-based design platforms such as Canva and Miricanvas** may experience unexpected issues such as color differences, font errors, and broken images when printed, and these issues are not eligible for rework.
product.general_precautions_2: For stable print quality, we recommend using files created with Adobe programs (Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop).
product.general_precautions_3: All printed materials are output based on CMYK, and there may be a color difference between the monitor screen and the actual printed material.
product.general_precautions_4: Please make sure to outline all fonts.
product.general_precautions_5: We recommend a resolution of 300dpi or higher for print images, and we are not responsible for any quality degradation caused by the use of low-resolution images.
product.general_precautions_6: Due to the cutting process, an error of ±1–2mm may occur, so please ensure sufficient margin for important elements.
product.general_precautions_7: Proofreading confirmation is considered final approval, and rework is not possible for issues that arise after approval.
product.general_precautions_8: There may be a difference of approximately ±5–10% between the data colors and the actual printed colors.
product.general_precautions_9: Even with the same data, color differences may occur depending on the type of paper.
product.general_precautions_10: If you wish to reproduce the exact same color as your previous order, you must provide the existing printout or color sample.
product.shipment_delivery_1: The dispatch date refers to the period from the date of receipt completion to the completion of production, and does not include the delivery period.
product.shipment_delivery_2: The provided shipping date is an estimate and may differ from the actual shipping date depending on the production process, volume, and work status.
product.shipment_delivery_3: For printed materials where the schedule is critical, you must request a preliminary consultation before placing an order. Refunds and compensation are not possible under any circumstances due to failure to confirm the production schedule.
product.shipment_delivery_4: For large orders or orders involving special finishing processes (coating, die-cutting, binding, etc.), additional time may be required beyond the stated shipping date.
product.shipment_delivery_5: All printed materials shipped from our company are inspected according to process standards, rather than through full inspection.
product.shipment_delivery_6: Shipment may be delayed or not dispatched due to unavoidable circumstances of our company or the courier, and no separate compensation will be provided for this.

product.instruction_load_options:
Saving your options is convenient because you don't have to select them every time you place an order.
When saving, you can specify an option name and memo. Saved options can be searched by product, option name, or memo in [My Page] → [My Activity] → [Load Options].
Saved options can only be loaded for the same product. Because printing specifications differ by product, options saved for Best Seller Business Cards cannot be loaded for General Business Cards.
Saved options do not change automatically based on the file you upload. Please review and change the required options yourself to match the file's specifications and content.
product.schedule_release_note:
The shipping date refers to the period from order confirmation to production completion and does not include the delivery period.



The estimated shipping date provided is based on the expected production schedule. The actual shipping date may vary depending on production processes, order volume, and operational conditions.



For printed materials with strict deadlines, customers must request a consultation before placing an order. Refunds or compensation due to failure to verify the production schedule in advance will not be provided under any circumstances.



For bulk orders or orders requiring special finishing processes (such as coating, die-cutting, binding, etc.), additional production time may be required beyond the estimated shipping date.

my.corporate_note_1: Electronic tax invoices are issued as a single invoice at the beginning of the following month (before the 10th), based on the total order amount for the current month and calculated from the end of the month. (Individual issuance or pre-issuance is not possible.)
my.corporate_note_2: Electronic tax invoices are issued using only the business information registered to the corresponding ID and cannot be issued separately for different business registration numbers for each order. (If you have multiple business registration numbers, you must register for each with a separate business registration number.)
my.corporate_note_3: For card payments, the credit card receipt serves as proof, and a separate tax invoice is not issued.
my.individual_note_1: Cash receipts are issued as a single receipt at the beginning of the following month (before the 10th), based on the total sum of orders for the current month. (Individual issuance or pre-issuance is not possible.)
my.individual_note_2: Cash receipts are issued only to the mobile phone number registered to the corresponding ID and cannot be issued to different numbers for each order.
my.individual_note_3: If the number for the cash receipt differs from the worker's number, please register the assigned number in [Worker Management]. If you select the assigned number when placing an order, the cash receipt will be issued to the number registered in the basic information, and work-related SMS messages will be sent to the worker.
my.individual_note_4: For card payments, the card slip serves as proof, and a cash receipt is not issued.
my.please_select_bank: Please select a bank below and make the change.
my.dedicated_account_note: Important Notes When Applying for a Dedicated Account
my.dedicated_account_note_1: Only one dedicated account can be issued per ID.
my.dedicated_account_note_2: The dedicated account can be changed once a month starting 30 days after the application date, and if there is a deposit, it can be changed starting from the next day.
my.dedicated_account_note_3: If the dedicated account is not used for 12 months, it will be automatically deleted, and a new application is required to use it again.
my.dedicated_account_note_4: The dedicated account is a virtual account that cannot be deposited via ATM.
my.dedicated_account_note_5: It may take a few minutes for the deposit to be reflected in the system, and verification may be delayed during bank maintenance hours.
my.dedicated_account_note_6: Even if the depositor's name is different, if the deposit is made to the issued dedicated account, the settlement will be processed normally under that ID.
my.dedicated_account_note_7: Any overpayment will be automatically deducted from your future order payment.
my.dedicated_account_note_8: Payment via the dedicated account is possible for amounts of at least 300 won.
my.dedicated_account_note_9: We do not request deposits to accounts other than the dedicated account.
my.withdrawal_description: If you could point out any unsatisfactory aspects of using Printly, we will take them into consideration to improve our service.
my.withdrawal_warning: Upon membership withdrawal, any S Points you hold will be forfeited, and S Money will be transferred upon request.
my.please_check_inconveniences: Please check any inconveniences you experienced while using the service.
my.withdrawal_note_1a: Membership withdrawal is not possible if there are ongoing orders or unpaid balances.
my.withdrawal_note_2a: Upon membership withdrawal, the account will be deleted and cannot be restored.
my.withdrawal_note_2b: A withdrawn ID cannot be reused.
my.withdrawal_note_3a: All member benefits, including points, membership grade, and discount coupons, will expire immediately upon withdrawal.
my.withdrawal_note_3b: Points and benefits that expire after withdrawal cannot be restored.
my.withdrawal_note_4a: Posts and reviews written by the member will not be deleted after membership withdrawal.
my.withdrawal_note_5: Retention of Purchase and Transaction Information
my.withdrawal_note_5a: In accordance with e-commerce-related laws and regulations, certain information such as orders, payments, contracts, and transaction records will be retained for the legally required period.
my.withdrawal_note_5b: Information retained under applicable laws and regulations will be deleted without delay after the retention period ends.
my.withdrawal_note_6a: If there is a remaining deposit balance, a refund must be requested before membership withdrawal.
my.withdrawal_note_7: Service Restrictions and Improper Use Records
my.withdrawal_note_7a: Records related to service restrictions or improper use may be retained for a certain period in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.
my.enter_password_to_withdraw: Please enter your password\nto proceed with withdrawal.
my.refund_account_change_bank_note: Please enter the bank, account holder, and account number to update.
my.refund_detail_note: (Refund amounts are based on the settlement date)
my.refund_guide_1: Funds deposited into a member's dedicated account are treated as that member ID's deposit balance regardless of the depositor's name.
my.refund_guide_2: In principle, refunds are possible only when the registered member name matches the account holder name of the refund account.
my.refund_guide_3: If the refund-account information does not match the member information, the refund may be rejected or placed on hold.
my.refund_guide_4: If a deposit is made under a third party's name, any settlement or tax-related matters must be handled separately by the member and the depositor.
my.refund_guide_5: If an unusual transaction such as an incorrect deposit, identity misuse, or fraud is suspected, the refund and use of the deposit balance may be put on hold and additional verification documents may be requested.
my.refund_guide_6: If there are amounts requiring settlement, such as unpaid orders, those amounts will be deducted before the remaining balance is refunded.
my.refund_guide_7: If the deposit balance is used after a refund request is submitted, the refund will be based on the actual remaining balance.
my.review_caution_1: Reviews can only be written within 30 days of the product shipment.
my.review_caution_2: Points awarded for writing a review are not credited immediately upon registration but are selectively distributed based on internal criteria.
my.review_caution_3: For photo reviews, please upload a photo of the final printed product you actually received.
my.review_caution_4: Content containing profanity, slander, or false information may be deleted.
my.review_caution_5: In the following cases, you will be excluded from point eligibility and may be deleted without prior notice.
my.review_caution_5a: If you register content or photos unrelated to the product
my.review_caution_5b: In cases where meaningless sentences or the same content is repeated
my.review_caution_5c: If the photo or image contains personal information (uploading is possible after mosaic processing)
my.review_caution_5d: If the photo/image contains personal information (uploading is possible after mosaic processing)
my.review_caution_6: Please note that user reviews cannot be edited after submission.
my.saved_option_note_1: This feature allows you to conveniently purchase products by saving frequently used options.
my.saved_option_note_2: If you click "Order Product" in the saved options, you can place an order directly with the saved options.
my.saved_option_note_3: The file is not saved, so you must re-upload it when placing an order.
my.saved_option_note_4: For long-saved quotes, the quote amount may change due to the deletion or modification of options.
my.saved_option_note_5: The default search period for saved options is 1 year.
my.saved_option_note_6: Saved options are available only for the same product.
my.saved_option_note_7: Saved options cannot be modified. Please delete and re-register them.

order.shipping_note:
The estimated production date refers to the period from order confirmation to production completion and does not include the shipping period.



The indicated production date is an estimated schedule and may differ from the actual production date depending on production processes, order volume, and work conditions.



For printed materials with critical deadlines, please make sure to request prior consultation before placing an order. Refunds or compensation due to failure to confirm the production schedule will not be provided under any circumstances.

cart.note_10: Items that can be packed together are combined whenever possible to minimize shipping costs.
